Usage of cli:
  --add-dir                                Add a directory to the workspace (repeatable) (default [])
  --agent                                  Agent for the current CLI session
  --analytics_server_url                   Analytics server host
  --api_server_url                         API server host (default http://0.0.0.0:50001)
  --app_data_dir                           Path where application data is stored, relative to GeminiDir (default jetski)
  --beyond_quota_bucket                    Quota bucket to use for Beyond API calls (format: team/bucket)
  --bg-updater                             Run as background update worker
  --browser_eval_env                       Whether to enable browser eval environment setup (pre-installed playwright, CA certs, proxy/SSO)
  -c                                       Short alias for --continue
  --cdp_port                               Port for Chrome DevTools Protocol (default 9222)
  --cli_log_file                           Override log file path for CLI mode
  --cloud_code_endpoint                    CCPA API URL
  --continue                               Continue the most recent conversation
  --conversation                           Resume a previous conversation by ID
  --conversation_path                      Path to a trajectory file to resume from
  --csrf_token                             CSRF token for language server
  --dangerously-skip-permissions           Auto-approve all tool permission requests without prompting
  --debug                                  Enable debug view and line inconsistency checks
  --disable-slash-commands                 Disable slash command and skill expansion in print mode
  --disable_telemetry                      If true, disable telemetry logging
  --effort                                 Reasoning effort for the current CLI session (low|medium|high|xhigh|max)
  --enable_lsp                             If true, enable LSP
  --extension_server_csrf_token            CSRF token for extension server
  --extension_server_port                  Port to connect to the extension server. If unset, the extension server is not used. (default 0)
  --file_watch_max_dir_count               The max number of directories we will watch. (default 0)
  --gemini_dir                             Path where Gemini files are stored. If absolute path, will set directly. If relative path, will be resolved relative to HomeDir. (default .gemini)
  --host_bridge_url                        Loopback base URL of a host that serves HostBridgeService. If unset, no host is asked about itself.
  --http_server_port                       Port for HTTP language server. 0 means random. (default 0)
  --https_server_port                      Port for HTTPS language server. 0 means random. (default 0)
  -i                                       Short alias for --prompt-interactive
  --include-default-customizations         Include default customizations (default true)
  --inference_api_server_url               Inference API server host. If unset, uses default if not in enterprise mode
  --input-format                           Input format for print mode (text, stream-json). stream-json reads one NDJSON message per line from stdin and runs a turn for each; it requires --output-format stream-json (default text)
  --is_google3_workspace                   Deprecated: no-op.
  --is_google_internal                     Whether running in a Google internal environment.
  --isolated_env                           Run in an isolated environment with a temporary app data directory
  --json-schema                            Optional JSON schema string or path to a schema file to enforce structured output (for stream-json, only applicable to the final result)
  --limit_go_max_procs                     Cap GOMAXPROCS at this value (default 4)
  --local_chrome_headless                  Whether Chrome runs in headless mode. (default true)
  --local_chrome_user_data_dir             Chrome user data directory.
  --log-file                               Override CLI log file path
  --lsp_port                               Port for LSP protocol. 0 means random. (default 0)
  --mode                                   Set the agent execution mode for this session (accept-edits, auto, plan, bestn)
  --model                                  Model for the current CLI session
  --model_api_client_type                  Which model client to use: ccpa or gemini. Defaults to ccpa. (default ccpa)
  --mquery_for_context_module              Whether to enable mquery in the core context module. (default true)
  --new-project                            Create a new project for this session
  --output-format                          Output format for print mode (text, json, stream-json) (default text)
  --override_business_oauth_client_id      Override Business OAuth client ID
  --override_business_oauth_client_secret  Override Business OAuth client secret
  --override_ide_name                      Override IDE name in metadata (e.g. 'antigravity')
  --override_ide_version                   Override IDE version in metadata (e.g. '0.1.0')
  --override_oauth_client_id               Override OAuth client ID
  --override_oauth_client_secret           Override OAuth client secret
  --override_user_agent_name               Override user agent name for HTTP requests (e.g. 'antigravity-dev')
  -p                                       Short alias for --print
  --parent_pipe_path                       Parent pipe path for monitoring whether the parent process is still running
  --persistent_mode                        If true, run in persistent daemon mode: writes discovery file and doesn't exit when extension closes
  --print                                  Run a single prompt non-interactively and print the response
  --print-timeout                          Optional time limit for print mode; 0 waits until the turn completes (default 0s)
  --profile                                write profiles (cpu, heap, block) to files with this prefix
  --project                                Project ID or project name for the current CLI session
  --prompt                                 Alias for --print
  --prompt-interactive                     Run an initial prompt interactively and continue the session
  --read_host_bridge_token_from_stdin      Read bearer token for the host bridge from stdin
  --release_base_url                       Base URL of the release server for the auto-updater
  --repl_mode                              Whether to run CLI in REPL mode (stdin/stdout REPL)
  --request_criticality                    Override loadshedding criticality for Beyond API calls (allowed values: SHEDDABLE, SHEDDABLE_PLUS, CRITICAL, CRITICAL_PLUS) (default CRITICAL_PLUS)
  --sandbox                                Run in a sandbox with terminal restrictions enabled
  --stamp                                  If true, print stamp information and exit
  --standalone                             Whether to run in standalone mode
  --use_custom_page_actions                Whether to enable the actuation overlay functionality (default true)
  --use_host_auth                          Use HostAuthProvider via HostBridgeService for OAuth authentication
  --use_local_chrome                       Whether to use local chrome
  --use_ls_chrome_devtools_mcp             Whether to start the Chrome DevTools MCP server (default true)
  --use_stubby_auth                        Use LOAS auth instead of OAuth browser flow. Only for use in Standalone + internal mode.
  --use_test_gaia                          Generate a GAIA thinmint in the test domain. Otherwise use the prod domain.
  --workspace_id                           Workspace ID

Available subcommands:
  agent           List available agents
  agents          List available agents
  changelog       Show changelog and release notes
  chatski         Connect your Jetski LS to Chatski (internal)
  help            Show help for subcommands
  hub             Interact with the Jetski Hub (internal)
  install         Configure environment paths and shell settings
  mcp             Manage MCP servers (add, remove, list, enable, disable)
  mic-serve       Serve this machine's microphone to a CLI on another host
  models          List available models
  plugin          Manage plugins (install, uninstall, list, enable, disable)
  plugins         Alias for plugin
  remote-control  Manage the remote-control background daemon (start, status, stop)
  web             Alias for hub
